title: Scheduled trigger contract: Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers as the shipped shape (scope global, new topic scheduledTriggerContract)
context: An applying Workers project has one native scheduled-trigger answer today: Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers. Cron expressions are declared in wrangler.toml under [triggers] crons per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/; the shipped runtime invokes a scheduled(event, env, ctx) handler on each fire per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/handlers/scheduled/. Cron Triggers fire on a best-effort basis; wrangler dev exposes a --test-scheduled CLI seam that lets a reviewer drive a scheduled fire deterministically per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/commands/#dev. The v1.0.0 dispatcher holds the routing reference opaque at the handler boundary so a future non-Cloudflare adapter or an in-process adapter for tests slots in without a handler re-shape, and so the round-6 Durable Objects sibling and the follow-up Workflows adapter on jobs-background land as separate concerns.
decision: The shipped v1.0.0 default is Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers, wired through wrangler config ([triggers] crons per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/) with the scheduled(event, env, ctx) handler shape as the sole reader of the Cron Trigger event per REQ-001. The scheduledTriggerContract topic scope is global on this blueprint; the topic string is scheduledTriggerContract (lower camelCase, one concept per topic, no version suffix, per the round-2 rules-for-new-topics clause on the shelf registry). A future non-Cron-Triggers scheduler (a cross-region cron on a different platform, a durable-workflow scheduler on the round-6 Durable Objects sibling) would contribute the same topic string with a different answer, forcing a DELIBERATE conflict the operator resolves with a project-level ADR per the round-2 conflict pattern.
consequences: The applying project inherits the Cron Triggers wire format, the platform-assigned per-Worker cron limits (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/), and the documented best-effort schedule. Standards trace clause: Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers documented shape (per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/). Consumer code needing strong-scheduled semantics (a durable workflow with retries and state across fires) reaches for the follow-up Workflows adapter on the round-6 jobs-background v1.1.0 minor bump (per spec section 5.7); the guide carries the decision-tree cross-reference between platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers (recurring cadence, statelessness) and jobs-background (durable, retried, workflow-shaped).
